en: Colorized panoramic view of a town in a river valley with many houses and church spires, titled 'MARBURG a. Dr.' on the front. Handwritten notes appear on the image. The reverse is a divided-back German-language postcard with an Austrian 5‑heller green stamp and a circular postmark reading 'MARBURG a. d. DRAU'. It includes a long handwritten message and a purple round library stamp.
